TITLE: DDezinformacja
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Paste a link to an article or a site. You'll see the registry record, whether CERT Polska lists the name, the first saved copy, and how often the name is visited.
LONG_DESCRIPTION: DDezinformacja checks a news link against the public registry, the CERT Polska warning list, the Wayback Machine, and the Tranco visit ranking.
HERO.HEADING: Check the site behind a link
ERROR.INCORRECT_LINK: That doesn't look like a web link.
META.DESCRIPTION: Paste a news link and check the registry record, the CERT Polska warning list, the first saved copy, and how often the name is visited.
IDLE.HEADING: What you'll see
IDLE.DATES: How long the name has been taken, and until when it is paid
IDLE.AGE: How old the site name is
IDLE.OWNER: Which company and country the registry lists, when it lists them
IDLE.CERT: Whether CERT Polska lists the name for phishing or scams
IDLE.WAYBACK: The earliest copy saved by the Wayback Machine
IDLE.TRANCO: How often people visit the name, from the Tranco list
CHECK.SOURCE: Source: the public directory of site names (RDAP).
CHECK.YOUNG_DOMAIN: Domain is less than a year old
CHECK.YOUNG_DOMAIN_WHY: A large newsroom usually uses a name registered a long time ago.
CHECK.OWNER_HIDDEN_WHY: The registry left out the organization. For .com and .net that is the usual case.
CHECK.SUMMARY.AGE: The name {{domain}} has been registered for {{age}}
CHECK.SUMMARY.NO_AGE: The public registry has a record for {{domain}}, with no registration date
CHECK.SUMMARY.NO_ORG: The record does not list an organization
CHECK.HINT.AGE: Time since this name was first registered.
CHECK.HINT.REGISTERED: The day the name was first registered.
CHECK.HINT.ORGANIZATION: Company or institution in the public record.
CHECK.HINT.REGISTRAR: The company the name was registered through. That company is not necessarily the author of the site.
CHECK.HINT.EXPIRES: End of the paid period. Names are usually renewed before this day, so the site does not shut down then.
CHECK.HINT.UPDATED: The last change to this record.
CHECK.HINT.STATUS: Flags from the registry. Each one has a plain meaning beside it.
CHECK.HINT.NAMESERVERS: Servers that say where this name points. They often show the hosting company.
CHECK.ERROR.UNSUPPORTED: No registration service is available for this ending (such as .pl or .com), so there is no public record to show.
CHECK.ERROR.NOT_FOUND: This name was not found in the public registry.
CHECK.ERROR.RATE_LIMIT: The registry is limiting how many lookups it answers. Try again in a moment.
CHECK.ERROR.NETWORK: The registry could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.client transfer prohib: The company that registered the name has blocked transfers to another company.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.server transfer prohib: The registry has blocked transfers to another company.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.client delete prohibit: The company that registered the name has blocked deletion.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.client update prohibit: The company that registered the name has blocked changes to this record.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.server update prohibit: The registry has blocked changes to this record.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.client renew prohibite: The company that registered the name has blocked renewal.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.client hold: The company that registered the name has suspended it. The site may not load.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.server hold: The registry has suspended this name. The site may not load.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.inactive: The name is not connected to any servers, so the site may not load.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.pending transfer: The name is being moved to another company.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.pending update: A change to this record is in progress.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.redemption period: The name was deleted recently and can still be restored.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.auto renew period: The registry just renewed the name automatically.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.add period: The name was registered very recently.
CHECK.STATUS_TEXT.transfer period: The name was just moved to another company.
CERT.LOADING: Checking the CERT Polska warning list for {{domain}}...
CERT.LISTED: This name is on the CERT Polska warning list
CERT.CLEAR: Not on the CERT Polska warning list
CERT.NOTE: The list is about phishing and scams. It does not say whether a news story is true.
CERT.HINT: CERT Polska publishes names used for phishing and other scams. A match warns about the site. It is not a verdict on an article.
CERT.ERROR_HEADING: Could not check the warning list
CERT.ERROR.NETWORK: The warning list could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
CERT.ERROR.UNAVAILABLE: The warning list is temporarily unavailable.
WAYBACK.LOADING: Looking for the earliest saved copy of {{domain}}...
WAYBACK.PAGE_ON: This page was first saved on {{date}}.
WAYBACK.NONE: The Wayback Machine has no saved copy of this name.
WAYBACK.PAGE_NONE: This page has no saved copy.
WAYBACK.PAGE_ERROR: This page could not be checked.
WAYBACK.OPEN_PAGE: Open the saved copy of this page
WAYBACK.HINT: The Internet Archive saves copies of pages. The date is the earliest copy that opened as a normal page, not the day the site was created.
WAYBACK.ERROR_HEADING: Could not reach the Wayback Machine
WAYBACK.ERROR.NETWORK: The Wayback Machine could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
WAYBACK.ERROR.UNAVAILABLE: The Wayback Machine is temporarily unavailable.
TRANCO.HINT: Tranco ranks names by how often people visit them. Rank 1 is the most visited. Outside the top million only means the name is less common.
TRANCO.ERROR_HEADING: Could not read the Tranco list
TRANCO.ERROR.NETWORK: The Tranco list could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
TRANCO.ERROR.RATE_LIMIT: The list is limiting lookups. Try again in a moment.
TRANCO.ERROR.UNAVAILABLE: The Tranco list is temporarily unavailable.
